title: Ivo and the Witness
author: Lior Eriksen
blurb: Ada Iversen, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
